title: Morse Code and NATO Alphabet
description: For beginners learning International Morse letters A–Z and digits 0–9, plus all 26 NATO spelling words. Dots and dashes show signals; NATO words spell letters and are not Morse sounds.

sources.name: Original explanations of standard symbol mappings
ITU-R M.1677-1: International Morse code
sources.license: ITU reference standard; mappings stated as facts

sources.name: NATO: The NATO phonetic alphabet
sources.license: NATO public reference; mappings stated as facts
